text:
maya: Quick sync — we have a dep chain blocking merges. SDK PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 wants an API change in https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/211. Console PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/789 depends on the API contract, and helm chart https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/55 needs an image tag bump after runtime change. Can we sequence merges tomorrow during the 10am PT merge window? Need reviewers/approvals. TL;DR: API -> SDK -> Console -> Helm.

alex_g: I can review SDK PR this afternoon. Is the API change backwards compatible?

drew: API change is minor, but it adds a required field to /v1/models response. Not strictly backward compatible. We have an API dev flag that can gate it. CI: SDK unit tests pass, but integration tests fail against current runtime. Error: `kv-cache mismatch` in runtime-integration. I'll paste failing log.

drew: ```
FAIL: tests/integration/test_runtime_compat.py::test_kv_cache
AssertionError: expected 409 got 200
logs:
[... runtime] KV cache header mismatch at token 42
```

jen: Console PR 789 includes a UI change that reads the new field; Console can fallback if field missing. But we need an API contract bump so Console team can feature-flag behind `feature.new_model_field`.

maya: OK — plan proposal: (1) Merge API behind dev-flag + rollout at 0% (canary) (2) Merge SDK with compatibility layer and run integration tests against patched runtime image in staging (3) Merge Console with feature flag off (4) Helm chart bump once runtime image with patched KV cache is available. Who can champion step 2 and 4?

sam: I can own step 4 — I'll build a runtime image with the KV fix and push tag `runtime:kvfix-20260317`. Will open a PR to helm-charts to bump image tag. ETA 2pm PT.

alex_g: I'll take step 2 (run SDK integration tests). Need exact runtime image to test against. @sam please ping when image is up.

merge-bot: Scheduled merge window tomorrow 2026-03-18 17:00:00 UTC. Will auto-merge eligible PRs with label `merge/window` if CI passes.

maya: sweet. @drew can you coordinate API rollout flags? Need a short note in API PR about how to rollback.

drew: Yep. I'll add feature flag gating and docs in api PR 211. Also adding endpoint header `X-Redwood-API-Version: 2026-03-17` for quick routing check.

jen: For Console, I'll add a server-side toggle and unit tests. Can we add a QA checklist? e.g., `smoke + integration + front-end visual check`.

maya: I'll add checklist to the SDK PR and add reviewers: @alex_g, @drew, @jen. Also tagging @ops for canary window. ops on call: @vijay?

vijay: I can watch the canary and rollback if errors spike. Please post monitor links.

maya: Great — can everyone drop one-line availability for tomorrow 10am PT? alex_g?

alex_g: 10am PT works for me. Will start reviews 2pm today.

drew: I'm available 10-11am PT, then afternoon.

jen: In for 9:30-11:30am PT.

sam: will be online 1-3pm PT to build image and open helm PR.

maya: Awesome. I'll create a tiny runbook in the API PR and add `merge/window` labels once CI green. Thanks all :tada:
